items.name: Multiattack
entries: The eyestalk attacks with its bite and uses Eradication Gaze.

items.name: Eradication Gaze {@recharge 5}
entries: The eyestalk creates an area of magical devastation in a 150-foot cone. Any creature in that area must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or take 55 ({@damage 10d10}) necrotic damage. If this damage reduces a creature to 0 hit points, its body becomes a pile of fine violet dust.
Gzemnid is a beholder god of deception, gases, and obscurement.

The realm of the beholder deity Gzemnid lies beneath the Outlands. Most entrances into these mysterious, gas-filled caverns are found near chaotically aligned gate-towns—like Bedlam, Sylvania, or Xaos—but Gzemnid's Realm is elusive, even by the mutable standards of the Outlands.
